findings.text: Any is used in three annotations (lines 59, 62, 65) and never imported, so ruff check reports three F821 and ruff format --check reports the module would be rewritten; the new file does not pass the repository's own lint and format gate.

the site's dedicated NOVA_EXACT_CLOSED_FORM_REPORT_ROOT override was removed with its literal, and the two variables at benchmarks/exact_clip_moment_floor.py:62-63 likewise, so a caller that pointed one benchmark elsewhere can no longer do so without moving the shared root for all 47 modules.

both baseline_suite and after_suite carry an unterminated log_path string and no completed key, so the recorded gate cannot be parsed by a machine reader even though the gate/base-summary.log and gate/head-summary.log behind them are sound.
the base arm fails on the self-check that benchmarks/receipt_locations.py exists, not on finding a literal, so the base arm alone does not show the scan fires; only the negative control shows that.

item_verdicts.goal: the goal is that no benchmark or supporting script carries an absolute crew-run or worktree path; an independent git grep at 8334897d5 over benchmarks/ and the five named scripts returns 0 lines against 61 at 624860447.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, both commits, gate job 1297670 with base 7 failure ids and head 2, and the negative control, though its baseline_suite and after_suite lines are not parseable JSON.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared paths name benchmarks, five script files, tests/test_evidence_tooling_paths.py and the evidence fragment; all 53 changed paths sit inside that list.

justifications.durability: tests/test_evidence_tooling_paths.py:61 fails on a restored literal as its negative control shows, and the accessor lives inside the scanned tree so a default literal there would redden, but no assertion covers the fail-by-name contract of benchmarks/receipt_locations.py:43 or the shell substitutions at scripts/analytic_oracle_fixtures/run_cached_radial.sh:4.
justifications.evidence: the census and both arm logs were read directly (gate/base-summary.log 7 ids, gate/head-summary.log 2 ids, 0 added), but the manifest's own receipt at manifest.md:13-14 is malformed JSON with no completed field, so the recorded gate is not machine-readable.
justifications.fit: benchmarks/receipt_locations.py:59 leaves Any unimported, so ruff check reports three F821 and ruff format --check would rewrite the new module, which lands outside the lint gate nova/AGENTS.md applies to touched paths.
